description.en: Unlocks a uniform set for the team, by uniform set ID.
ID of the uniform set to unlock, e.g. "iiu0001".
True once the call has taken effect (including as a no-op if the uniform system isn't ready yet); null if the call was invalid (no ID given).

example.code:
// Unlock the starting uniform set at the beginning of the game
CMND_ADD_SET_UNIFORM("iiu0001");
